blurb: Indexers, analytics and wallet APIs spanning many chains, many with MCP servers.

blurb: Prices, DeFi metrics and oracle feeds that agents read for decisions.

title: Prediction Market APIs
blurb: Public APIs for market odds, order books and forecasts.

title: Web Data for Agents
blurb: Search, crawl and scrape APIs designed for LLM and agent consumption.

title: MCP Registries and Hosting
blurb: Directories and hosts for MCP servers that expose data and tools to agents.
